title: Vegan Stir Fry
description: A delicious and easy-to-make vegan stir fry recipe with earthy flavors.

ingredients.name: Beef-free strips (such as portobello mushrooms or seitan)
Earthy oil (such as sesame or grapeseed oil)
Chopped vegetables (such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli)

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of earthy oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the cinnamon and stir-fry for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beef-free strips and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped vegetables and cook until they're tender-crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute, until the vegetables are coated.
Serve the stir-fry over cooked rice or noodles and enjoy!
Garnish with sesame seeds or chopped scallions, if desired.
